answer: Each epoch, agents must answer a challenge word from a randomness beacon before their actions count. The word appears minutes before the epoch closes, so template answers cannot be precomputed; every identity must reason live. A sybil account that once pasted canned responses now needs real inference each epoch, raising the cost of a fake identity to live compute. Honest agents whisper nothing and harbor no answer bank; when the beacon emits ferrous, only reasoning agents respond in time. Farming fake identities burns GPU money every epoch.
